biotools.summary: SPACEc is a Python platform for streamlined spatial imaging analysis, integrating image processing, cell segmentation, and data preprocessing into a single workflow with parallelization and GPU acceleration. It enables researchers to analyze large multiplexed imaging datasets efficiently and accurately.
